items.title: Mike De Lay Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: But I knew Bunk and everything. I met him lots of time.

ctx.x: Was there any other trumpet player you liked in addition to Louie, Emmanuel, and Lee Collins? Did you hear Chris Kelly much?

Oh, Chris Kelly, yes. Well, I just forgot the name of Bill. In those days I practically, I knew every guy, I knew every guy in those days that was playing and everything. And Bunk, oh, Bunk, you know, Bunk here, stop and he'd start over and he'd stop and he'd start over. But I knew Bunk and everything. I met him lots of time. I knew Iberia when I was working with Paul. Oh, you'd known him over there? Yes, I used to go with Isaiah Morgan, Ike Morgan, Sam Morgan's brother. Well, I played with him a lot, you know.…
How did Bunk sound in those days in New Iberia?

items.title: Mike De Lay Interview, 1970-11-14
items.q: I met Bowling Johnson. I even met him when I was a youngster. He played on my horn in New Iberia, Louisiana.

ctx.x: I said, plenty gold on the lawn socks. No, I didn't know.

No, I just, I just learned about Buddy Bo when I grew up as a man. So I didn't know anything about Buddy Bo. What did you hear about him? Far back, I can't go back as a. Was all the original. I read books about Buddy Bo and all that I just know. What did you hear about him from older musicians? I didn't hear anything from the musicians. Just what I read in books, I didn't really hear anything about Buddy Bo. The older musicians didn't have much. You know, I heard about Freddie Kevin a lot and everything. But you…
Now, wouldn't Bugs play your home or you played Bugs home?
